findings.title: All numbered success criteria have corresponding tasks
findings.description: Criteria 1–5 map to Tasks 1.1–1.4; 6–9 to 2.1–2.3; 10–11 to 3.1–3.4; 12 to 4.1–4.2; and 13–14 to Section 5. Dependencies are ordered without cycles, and tests accompany each implementation group. No substantive feature scope creep was found.

findings.title: Loader instructions silently accept explicit null
findings.description: Using `data.get("policy", None)` conflates an absent key with explicit YAML `policy: null`. The design requires any present value to be a string. Distinguish key absence from null and extend the existing non-string test to cover null rejection.

findings.title: Round-trip assertion is weaker than criterion 5
findings.description: Task 1.4 checks only that the reloaded policy matches. Criterion 5 also requires plain-string YAML output and equality of the complete reloaded `ServerConfig`. Strengthen this existing test’s assertions rather than adding another test task.

findings.title: Manual verification can undo the required shipped default
findings.description: “Whichever policy you want to keep” permits leaving `config/test.yaml` on `open` or `reflect`, violating criterion 12 after Task 4.2 has passed. Require restoration to `wrap` and verify it before closeout.

findings.title: Commit markers are checkbox items
findings.description: All five `**Commit**:` markers are checkboxes rather than required plain lines. Convert them to standalone markers after their tested work groups. Their placement after validation is otherwise appropriate.

findings.title: Task decomposition is heavier than the slice needs
findings.description: The small slice has 23 task headings, including five commit-only tasks. Merge Tasks 1.1–1.3 into one config implementation task, combine the two shipped-config edits, and replace commit-only tasks with plain markers. Tasks 5.1 and 5.2’s Step 2 duplicate the same final full-suite check; retain one. Preserve the focused tests and viewer walkthrough.
